initialization: Independently validated repaired school baseline shared by all seeds
neighborhood: MOVE/SWAP with feasibility screening before Metropolis; search is restricted to H=0
objective: Unchanged F=2H+S; H=0 within feasible search

selection.canonicalization: multiset placements within identical immutable assignment groups
selection.pool: best solution per completed SA run; initial unchanged solution excluded

stop_cohort_when: Three independent-validator-approved, pairwise-diverse SA best solutions available
authority: User explicitly requested three recommendations obtained using SA after diagnosis and explanation that a warm start is a methodology revision.
prior_frozen_artifacts: Preserved; this is a separate method and output cohort, not a replacement of old run results.
